principle: Only source-supported mappings may become verified. Name-derived candidates are explicitly labeled and cannot unlock the benchmark.

GSE185289.subject_rule: Extract the numeric animal identifier from the GEO source name/title; retain the full source name as provenance. Mark as high_candidate until cross-checked against the paper/source metadata.
GSE185289.condition_rule: Derive injury state from explicit arp1/mip28 fields: neither=reference; mip28 only=MI; arp1 only=apical_resection; both=double_injury_regenerative_context.
GSE185289.timepoint_rule: Use the explicit GEO harvest postnatal day field.
GSE185289.region_rule: Use the explicit heart zone field or the title suffix (AZ/BZ/CZ/IZ/RZ) only as a candidate requiring confirmation.

GSE130699.subject_rule: No subject identifier is present in the public sample title/design fields reviewed; do not infer independent animals from GSM IDs.
GSE130699.condition_rule: GEO sample fields explicitly define P1/P8 surgery age, day 1/day 3 collection, and MI/sham.
GSE130699.timepoint_rule: Use explicit developmental surgery age and post-surgical day as separate variables.

GSE153480.subject_rule: No public subject/animal identifier has been verified from the reviewed sample record; do not infer subjects from GSM IDs.
GSE153480.condition_rule: Use explicit P1/P8 surgery age, day 1/day 3 collection, and MI/sham design.
GSE153480.timepoint_rule: Keep developmental surgery age separate from post-surgical day.

GSE217494.subject_rule: Collapse paired GEX_sampleN and Ab_sampleN measurements onto the same heart/sample family; do not treat the 44 GEO records as 44 biological subjects. Underlying cohort size is 22 hearts.
GSE217494.condition_rule: Recover from the study's cell/sample metadata; do not infer from GEO record order.

GSE135310.subject_rule: Pooled multiplexed datasets may contain multiple biological animals; public series-level sample labels are insufficient for a safe subject split.
GSE135310.condition_rule: Recover from hashtag/sample metadata and study documentation.

GSE106472.subject_rule: Three series samples are distinct experimental samples, but biological subject identity is not verified in the public series record.
GSE106472.condition_rule: Keep WT MI, IRF3KO MI, and WT no-MI as distinct states; genotype must not be collapsed into injury.

GSE216211.subject_rule: Three public GEO records represent Sham, MI, and MI-E experimental groups; biological replicate count/identity is not established by series titles alone.
GSE216211.condition_rule: Keep Sham, MI, and MI-E distinct.

GSE269054.subject_rule: Recover subject identity from sample-level metadata before any cross-study claim.
GSE269054.condition_rule: Keep permanent MI, I/R-30, and traumatic needle injury separate; healthy/reference is separate.
